user_constraint: No hardware; literature/public data and simulation only
target_reference: Jetson AGX Xavier, LoudVA fixed public snapshot; not CPU-NPU calibration

eligible_numeric_inputs.interpretation: Concurrency-conditioned server response time and six-rail mean power; descriptive reference or carefully scoped queue-level surrogate only
not_allowed: rename rail sum as GPU dynamic power
use queue-including latency as batch execution time
treat nominal logging interval as verified timestamp
transfer Orin or NX calibration coefficients to AGX Xavier

required_negative_controls: zero sleep contrast / no confirmed DPM
transition cost dominates saved awake energy
simulation_policy.evaluation: same work, model, precision, deadlines, common time horizon and idle continuation; compare common best fixed policy and simple temperature threshold
simulation_policy.permitted_claim: Conditional simulation mechanism and parameter-region robustness; not measured AGX Xavier savings or temperature safety guarantee
